findings.text: §19 proposes extracting only the `coalesce(ce.source_file, cc.source_file)` RETURN expression into a function taking the example and chunk aliases, but the join that actually resolves the path — `OPTIONAL MATCH (…)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(…)` in `parallel.py:203` versus the divergent edge the helper's callers use — stays at each call site, so the shallow helper hides a string while the substantial behaviour and its edge remain spread across three sites

findings.reason: extending the existing owner removes the class of defect (divergent joins behind one shared string) instead of adding one more convention that importers must honour.
